get.summary: Player game logs: one row per player per game, newest first, across seasons.
get.description: Full-game box score lines, including games that had no Underdog Fantasy line. Read one player with player_id or an exact player name. Read in bulk with league and a season or date range, using view=compact and limit=1000. stats holds the keys listed in meta.stat_keys, in natural units; a stat missing from stats was not reported for that game and is not zero. stats_event_id and player.stats_player_id are the same ids /results serves, and fixture_id joins to /fixtures when the game was on the board. confirmed is false until the stat-correction re-read about four days after the game, so recent numbers can still change. Did-not-play rows are left out unless include_dnp=true. A game whose box could not be verified is absent, never partial. meta.coverage says which seasons and dates are loaded. Free plan: the last 10 games per player, or against one opponent; no league-wide or season-wide reads.
